Other macronutrients
For infants, no DRI was set for saturated fat, monounsaturated fat, trans-fatty acids, cholesterol or dietary ﬁber. Although some die-
tary ﬁber is present in the diet after solid foods are introduced, there are no data on ﬁber intakes in such young age groups and no
theoretical basis exists, which establishes a need for ﬁber at less than 1 year of age.
